items.dod: `pnpm --filter @falens/control test:integration` passes against a Testcontainers Postgres 16: migrations apply from an empty database, a run row is inserted and read back scoped by company_id
items.note: The literal command fails every time: pnpm --filter runs the packages/control script with cwd=packages/control, and vitest.workspace.ts lives at the repo root, so vitest reports 'No projects matched the filter "integration"'. The underlying behaviour the item is checking for (migrations apply from empty DB, a run row round-trips scoped by company_id) is proven by the equivalent root-level command `pnpm -s test:integration`, which is what tool/gate.sh's integration-tests stage actually runs and which passes 11/11 against a real Postgres 16 container -- evidence/U-010/integration.log. red.log (already in evidence/U-010/) shows the same three integration test files failing for want of implementation when packages/control/src was moved aside, i.e. the red run was captured before the code existed.

items.dod: a repository call without company_id throws `TenantScopeMissing`; the test packages/control/test/tenant-scope.test.ts fails without the guard and passes with it
items.note: Red run (guard absent, src moved aside) captured earlier in evidence/U-010/red.log; green run with all 3 tenant-scope tests passing captured this session in evidence/U-010/integration.log.

items.dod: after migration the evidence_rows partition for the current month exists and inserted rows carry expires_at thirty days ahead (test packages/control/test/evidence-partitions.test.ts)
`docker compose up -d postgres` followed by `pnpm -s migrate` exits 0 on a developer machine (evidence/U-010/migrate.log)
items.command: docker compose up -d postgres && pnpm -s migrate
items.note: An immediate migrate right after 'docker compose up -d' returns can hit ECONNRESET (postgres:16-alpine still reports 'health: starting' for ~2s), captured verbatim in migrate.log. A retry once pg_isready succeeds applies both migrations and exits 0; a second run is a correctly idempotent no-op. docker compose down -v was run afterward so nothing was left running.
